purpose: Protect the existing Stage 2 build, repair and verification intent and proven runtime integrations. Changes require an explicit reviewed contract revision.
created_from: canonical Kiyosaki Stage 2 source and shared MQL5 includes; 2026-10-23

api_signatures.regime_calc: ENUM_REGIME Calc(const double &high[], const double &low[], const double &close[], int totalBars)

requirements: classify using completed bars according to the authenticated EA contract
preserve the existing 12 regime input declarations and their spec-bound values
preserve score formula, scoring window, margin capture and margin penalty
preserve quantity, projected margin and take-profit helper semantics

strategy_and_execution: preserve authenticated Stage1 signal and exit logic
closed-bar only signals and reads per the active execution contract
preserve input names, types, defaults, domains and strategy-specific ranges
preserve margin guards, order refusal and emergency protection
preserve cycle lineage, source and binary hash binding
Stage2 does not launch MT5; Stage3 owns execution

change_policy.candidate_integration_repairs: permitted only for a named failed check; require committed transaction and all protected checks pass
change_policy.shared_contract_change: requires an explicit new contract version, regression evidence and code review
change_policy.historical_receipt: does not override a current contract version
